caption: The drawing shows a detailed depiction of a metallic object, which consists of two main vertical sections connected at the top by a curved, U-shaped loop. The two vertical sections each feature a circular loop at the upper end and are joined at the top by a brown, spiral-wrapped band that looks like coiled wire or leather. Both sides have riveted or studded decorative elements, with the right side showing more prominent round rivet-like spots and a larger, flat, circular patch near the middle. The metal sections are silver-gray in tone with areas that appear slightly darker due to shading, highlights, and wear. At the bottom ends of each vertical section hang two short segments of chain links in dull gray. The object is centered on a pale, cream-colored background with no other items or details, and the name "Arthur E. Reynolds" is written below the object in black script.
